item.title: Indlela yokuguqulela incwadi yakho kwiilwimi ezili-101 ngemizuzu
item.description: Isixhobo seGemini kunye nomguquleli oqhelekileyo kwiGoogle Docs zindivumele ukuba ndikwazi ukunyusa imibhalo iye kwinqanaba lehlabathi phantse ngoko nangoko kwaye ngexabiso eliphantsi. Ngenxa yesikripthi sam sokucubungula ibhetshi, ndinikezela ngenkonzo yokuguqulela uxwebhu lwakho ngokukhawuleza kwiilwimi ezingaphezu kwe-100 ngaphandle kokungenelela ngesandla. Kutheni isebenza: ⬧ Ikhawuleza kakhulu: Iilwimi ezili-101 kwimizuzu eli-15 (≈ imizuzwana eli-9 ngolwimi ngalunye kuxwebhu olunamagama angama-48,000). ⬧ Ukwanda: Gcina izihloko, uluhlu, iitafile, kunye nemifanekiso. ⬧ Ukonga: Ixabiso lokuguqulela incwadi kwiilwimi ezili-101 limalunga ne-€5 / $6 kuphela. Ngezantsi uza kufumana imiyalelo epheleleyo kunye nemigaqo yoku-odola inguqulelo ye-101 yomsebenzi wakho.

item.title: Indlela yokuhumusha incwadi yakho ngezilimi ezingu-101 ngemizuzu
item.description: Ithuluzi le-Gemini kanye nomhumushi ojwayelekile ku-Google Docs kungivumele ukuthi ngikhulise imibhalo iye ezingeni lomhlaba wonke cishe ngokushesha futhi ngezindleko eziphansi. Ngenxa yesikripthi sami sokucubungula amaqoqo, nginikeza isevisi yokuhumusha ngokushesha idokhumenti yakho ezilimini ezingaphezu kwe-100 ngaphandle kokungenelela ngesandla. Kungani kusebenza: ⬧ Ishesha kakhulu: Izilimi eziyi-101 ngemizuzu eyi-15 (≈ imizuzwana eyi-9 ngolimi ngalunye kudokhumenti enamagama angu-48,000). ⬧ Ukukwazi Ukukhula: Gcina izihloko, uhlu, amathebula, nezithombe. ⬧ Ukonga: Izindleko zokuhumusha incwadi ngezilimi eziyi-101 zingama-€5 kuphela / $6. Ngezansi uzothola imiyalelo ephelele kanye nemigomo yoku-oda ukuhumusha okungu-101 komsebenzi wakho.
